evidence_limits: Primary references identify exact release archives and their legal members, immutable upstream source, or first-party license files. No raw METADATA, model-card HTML, capture paths or repeated legal texts are included.

Release metadata and classifiers alone do not verify permission. Project terms are separate from bundled notices. mentioned_terms is a text-signature index, not a conjunctive SPDX expression or proof of linkage.

Original large-wheel legal inspection used HTTP Range ZIP members and CRC checks. Expected archive hashes were not whole-download verification. Small downloaded sdists were hash-checked. Not every platform/Python wheel was legally compared.

R1/R2 installed versions and legal payloads do not prove complete source-to-binary provenance. R3 is resolved only. B1/B2 observations do not pin future isolated builds or reconstruct historical native tool versions.
Models, data, privacy and deployment rights are separate. This inventory does not clear third-party environment/model bundles or establish Linux/CUDA support.

obligation_catalog.notices: Retain applicable copyright, license conditions, warranty disclaimers, NOTICE and third-party notices with distributions. An umbrella metadata license does not replace component terms.
obligation_catalog.apache: Apache-2.0: provide license, preserve attribution/NOTICE, mark modified upstream files; no trademark grant; patent license and termination terms apply.
obligation_catalog.bsd: BSD/ISC/MIT variants: retain required notices/disclaimers; BSD-3-Clause forbids using author/contributor names for endorsement without permission.
obligation_catalog.weak-copyleft: LGPL/MPL: preserve full terms and notices; provide covered/modified source and applicable build/relink/replacement or installation information when conveying binaries/combined works. Ordinary use is not the same as distribution. Scope depends on library/file and artifact.
obligation_catalog.gpl: GPL-3.0: conveying a covered combined/derivative work requires GPL-compatible terms for that work, Corresponding Source and applicable installation information; permissive first-party code can be included but must not be offered as an exclusively permissive complete combined distribution.
obligation_catalog.gcc-exception: Bundled GPL runtime text includes GCC Runtime Library Exception 3.1: evaluate eligible compilation/independent-module conditions; do not classify NumPy/SciPy themselves as GPL merely because runtime license text is present. Preserve runtime terms and source obligations for the runtime itself.
obligation_catalog.proprietary: NVIDIA vendor EULA: permission is purpose/component-specific, not a general open-source grant. Review deployment restrictions, authorized redistribution/redistributables, notices, third-party terms and agreement requirements for the actual platform/package. Do not relicense vendor binaries under the first-party license.
obligation_catalog.bundled: Review individual legal files and the selected binary artifact before redistributing an environment. Metadata does not replace bundled grants. A license document does not prove every named component is linked.
obligation_catalog.font: Font-specific terms (including OFL/reserved font names where applicable) remain with bundled fonts; code license does not cover all font redistribution/modifications.
obligation_catalog.unresolved: Do not assert clearance for the unresolved component or convey the affected aggregate until its exact grant/provenance gap is closed. Apply the record-specific release gate, not a blanket first-party release prohibition.
obligation_catalog.toolchain-agreement: Use and distribution must meet the applicable Xcode/Apple SDKs agreement and included open-source terms. No blanket toolchain redistribution grant or agreement acceptance is inferred.
